title: Code change review
description: Every pull request merged to main in payroll-core has at least one approval from someone other than the author and is not merged with an administrator bypass.

title: Infrastructure change approval
description: Every production infrastructure change ticket is approved before it is implemented.

title: Termination deprovisioning
description: Identity provider access for a terminated workforce member is removed within one business day of the termination date.

title: Quarterly access review
description: System owners review production user access each quarter and complete and sign the review within 30 days of quarter end.

title: MFA enforcement
description: Every active identity provider account is enrolled in multi-factor authentication.

title: New-hire security training
description: New workforce members complete security awareness training within 30 days of their hire date.

title: Vulnerability remediation
description: Critical and high vulnerabilities are remediated within the SLA in the vulnerability management policy.

title: Backup restore testing
description: A restore of the production database from backup is tested each quarter.

title: Incident response exercise
description: The incident response plan is exercised with a tabletop at least annually.

title: Vendor risk review
description: Critical vendors are reviewed annually against their latest assurance report.
